visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair and bangs stands in a brightly lit indoor home setting, wearing a light blue t-shirt. She speaks directly to the camera with animated facial expressions and hand gestures. (2) She holds up a large yellow plastic bag with red lettering, which she begins to open excitedly. (3) She pulls out a cardboard box from the yellow bag, placing it on a wooden surface in front of her. (4) She shows a small yellow booklet, flipping through the pages to display images of burgers and nuggets inside. (5) She holds up a small, square fabric handkerchief featuring a cartoon character in a mask, still in its clear plastic packaging. (6) She presents a silver stainless steel cup shaped like a soda can, rotating it to show a large 'M' logo on one side and 'Coca-Cola' branding on the other. (7) She displays a plastic clip shaped like a chicken nugget dipped in sauce, opening it to show the interior mechanism. (8) She reveals a large burger-shaped toy that unfolds to reveal an orange electric fan. She points at the screws on the bottom and a small switch. (9) She demonstrates the fan's operation by holding it close to her face, looking surprised as the air blows. (10) She holds up multiple unboxed items simultaneously toward the camera while concluding her speech.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-pitched female vocals begin speaking rapidly with an enthusiastic tone. An upbeat electronic synthesizer BGM with a steady 4/4 drum beat starts immediately. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect triggers as text graphics appear on the screen. (3) Continuous rustling sounds from plastic material are heard as the host opens the bag. (4) A 'ta-da' chime sounds as a new item is revealed. Music remains steady in volume behind the speech. (5) Sound of flipping paper pages as she shows the coupon booklet. (6) A high-pitched metallic 'tink' SFX highlights the reveal of the cup. (7) A percussive 'click' and 'snap' sound accompanies the demonstration of the nugget clip. (8) A cartoon-style 'boing' SFX plays. (9) A low-frequency mechanical whirring sound of a small motor starts as the fan is turned on. (10) Female voice lets out a surprised, slightly comedic shout ('Wah!') in response to the fan's power. Music fades out with a final beat.
